desc: Ideation: identify contribution method and monotonic stack approach.
Implement the four boundary arrays with correct handling of duplicates (prev_less uses `>=`, next_le uses `>`, prev_greater uses `<=`, next_ge uses `<`).
Implement `count_pairs(A, B, K)` that returns the number of pairs (a,b) with 0 ≤ a < A, 0 ≤ b < B, and a + b ≤ K-1 (where A and B are the left/right extension counts).
Combine contributions: sum over i of `nums[i] * (count_pairs(prev_less[i], next_le[i], k) + count_pairs(prev_greater[i], next_ge[i], k))`.
Validate on the two given examples and ensure they match.
Stress test with edge cases: k=1, k=n, all-equal array, and random small arrays against brute force.
Verify time complexity O(n) and space O(n) for n up to 80,000.
